node: Data-center electrical equipment: switchgear, transformers, busway, backup power, and power distribution
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-market universe for the electrical-infrastructure chokepoint behind AI/data-center buildouts. Obvious context anchors remain Eaton, Vertiv, Schneider/ABB/Siemens, and GE Vernova, but this pass prioritizes less obvious US-listed names where data-center demand may appear in backlog, book-to-bill, segment mix, qualification awards, or niche product disclosures before it is fully captured by broad AI narratives. The strongest underfollowed evidence in this pass is Powell Industries because it has explicit data-center mega-order and backlog signals. Atkore, Generac, and Bel Fuse are included as second-order or narrower hypotheses tied to cable management, backup generation, and power/protection/connectivity components, respectively. This is a research universe expansion only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
